final_message:
I'll look through the repo and the HAR recording so the test matches how the household asks for items that run out within three days.The recording shows milk expiring on the same day the household asks, and the answer only includes yogurt. I'll add a test that replays that request and expects milk in the list.`test_expiring_includes_an_item_that_runs_out_today` in `tests/test_api.py` replays the recorded session and fails.

The household adds milk that runs out on 2026-10-21 and yogurt that runs out on 2026-10-23, then asks for what runs out within three days of 2026-10-21. The test expects both items. The API returns only yogurt, so milk that runs out today is missing.

The new test fails. The other 11 tests pass. The defect is still in the code.
